The '''European Chapter on Combinatorial Optimization (also, EURO Working Group on Combinatorial Optimization, or EWG ECCO)''' 
is a [[working group]] whose objective is to promote original research in the field of [[combinatorial optimization]] at the 
European level.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.euro-online.org/web/ewg/9/ewg-ecco-european-chapter-on-combinatorial-optimization | title=EURO - the Association of European Operational Research Societies - EWG ECCO, EURO working group on Combinatorial Optimization}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=http://ecco.grenoble-inp.fr | title=European Chapter on Combinatorial Optimization - Welcome}}</ref>

== History ==
ECCO is one of the working groups of EURO, the [[Association of European Operational Research Societies]]. 
The Group was founded in 1987 by Catherine Roucairol, [[Alexander Rinnooy Kan]], and Dominique de Werra.		
								
== Governance ==
The group is managed by an Advisory Board of 4 members and a Coordinator. The Advisory Board is currently composed of [[Jacek Błażewicz]],
Van Dat Cung, Alain Hertz, and [[Paolo Toth]]. The current coordinator is [[Silvano Martello]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ecco.grenoble-inp.fr/index.php?page=2|title=Advisory Board|publisher=ECCO|access-date=2024-05-12}}</ref>

== Membership ==
The group is suitable for people who are presently engaged in Combinatorial Optimization, either in theoretical aspects or in business, 
industry or public administration applications. Currently (2022), the group has over 1,600 members from 75 countries.

== Conferences ==

ECCO holds conferences on a regular basis (once a year during Spring). An abstract booklet is distributed to the participants at each 
meeting.

== Publications ==
In most cases, the annual conference is followed by a peer reviewed special issue of an international journal, presenting a selection 
of the contributions presented at the meeting. Recent special issues appeared on ''Annals of Operations Research'' 
,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://link.springer.com/journal/10479/207/1/page/1|title=Annals of Operations Research, Volume 207, Issue 1 - Springer}}</ref> 
''Optimization'',<ref>{{Cite journal | doi=10.1080/02331934.2013.850255|title = An overview of advances in combinatorial optimization related topics| journal=Optimization| volume=62| issue=10| pages=1291–1295|year = 2013|last1 = Martello|first1 = Silvano| last2=Weber| first2=Gerhard-Wilhelm| last3=Kasimbeyli| first3=Refail|s2cid = 122936119| hdl=11511/56332| hdl-access=free}}</ref>   
''Journal of Scheduling'',<ref>{{Cite journal | doi=10.1007/s10951-010-0170-4|title = Combinatorial optimization issues in scheduling| journal=Journal of Scheduling| volume=14| issue=3| pages=221–223|year = 2011|last1 = Blazewicz|first1 = Jacek| last2=Boljunčić| first2=Valter| last3=Martello| first3=Silvano| last4=Skorin-Kapov| first4=Jadranka|s2cid = 36802205}}</ref> 
''Discrete Applied Mathematics'',<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/journal/0166218X/196 |title=Discrete Applied Mathematics &#124; Advances in Combinatorial Optimization |work=[[Science Direct]] |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |date= |accessdate=2022-08-25}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/discrete-applied-mathematics/vol/242/suppl/C |title=Discrete Applied Mathematics &#124; Computational Advances in Combinatorial Optimization |work=[[Science Direct]] |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |date= |accessdate=2022-08-25}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/discrete-applied-mathematics/vol/264/suppl/C |title=Discrete Applied Mathematics &#124; Combinatorial Optimization: between Practice and Theory |work=[[Science Direct]] |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |date= |accessdate=2022-08-25}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/discrete-applied-mathematics/vol/290/suppl/C |title=Discrete Applied Mathematics &#124; Vol 290, Pages 1-132 (15 February 2021) |work=[[Science Direct]] |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |date= |accessdate=2022-08-25}}</ref>
and ''Journal of Combinatorial Optimization''.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://link.springer.com/journal/10878/volumes-and-issues/42-2 | title=Journal of Combinatorial Optimization &#124; Volume 42, issue 2 }}</ref>

A newsletter is emailed to all members every three months.
